verdict.rationale: CrewAI is an agent framework with a managed AMP platform, so a training-data opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented training opt-out, data-usage policy, or privacy control. Choosing among LLM providers is a user-side workaround and earns no credit, and the 'train' CLI command refers to training crews, not to how user data is used.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
